summary: Prices are the 6 Nov closes. The S&P 500 gained 0.3% on Friday but lost 2.7% on the week, its worst week since April 2025, while the Nasdaq Composite rose 1.1% and the Dow fell 0.5%. Overnight Asia rebounded: the Nikkei rose 3.4% to 59,411, the Kospi 1.5% to 5,137, the Taiex about 5.6% on a 5.6% TSMC rebound, the Hang Seng 0.2% and the Shanghai Composite 0.4%, with US futures higher (AP, 9 Nov). Brent traded near 98 dollars on Monday, down about 16% on the week on the January contract, as US-Iran talks continued alongside limited US strikes, and spot gold rose about 1.25% to about 4,122 dollars. US October payrolls rose 165,000 against roughly 65,000 expected, lifting odds of a December Fed hike, and China's October producer prices rose 5.7% from a year earlier. European shares fell on Friday, with the DAX down 1.9%.

climate.headline: NOAA: strong-to-very strong El Nino likely through early 2027
climate.detail: Nino-3.4 is +2.1C; chance of a strong event through Jan-Mar 2027 exceeds 83%, and of a record-class event 83% for Oct-Dec. Next update 12 November. Panama Canal draft was raised to 49 ft on 15 October, with Gatun Lake slightly above its 10-year average (ICIS, 5 Oct).
climate.source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, 8 Oct 2026; Panama Canal Authority via ICIS, 5 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Rhine at Kaub falls to 21 cm as no significant rain is forecast
climate.detail: The gauge read 21 cm on 2 November, down from 44 cm on 30 October; all measuring points are classed as low water. Forecast shows no signal for significant rain by about 10 November. The gauge is not the channel depth.

climate.headline: IEA: EU gas stores 75% full, lowest start to winter since 2013
climate.detail: EU storage stood at 75% at the end of October. The IEA said the bloc is particularly exposed to a colder winter or technical outages, raising reliance on global LNG at peak demand.
climate.source: International Energy Agency report via MLex, 3 Nov 2026

climate.headline: COP31 opens in Antalya on 9 November; leaders meet 11-12 November
climate.detail: The Turkish presidency, led by Minister Murat Kurum, has set nine action-agenda priorities, including food security, resilient cities and clean-energy transition. Erdogan, Guterres and Albanese are due to speak at the opening.
climate.source: Turkish Ministry of Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change briefing via Yeni Safak (undated report)

climate.headline: BoM: very strong El Nino to peak in November-December, positive IOD likely
climate.detail: Above-average rain is likely for much of Australia from November to January, but below average in southern Victoria, Tasmania and the far north. Temperatures are very likely above average across most of the country.
climate.source: Bureau of Meteorology (Australia), climate outlook issued 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: India monsoon ended 12% below normal, with the south 24% short
climate.detail: Rainfall for 1 June to 29 September was 758.5 mm against a normal 865 mm. East and northeast India were 25% below normal; 14 states were rainfall-deficient. The report attributes the shortfall mainly to El Nino.
climate.source: IMD data via Down To Earth, 30 Sep 2026

climate.headline: Vietnam forecasts Mekong inflow below average into 2027
climate.detail: Flows into Vietnam are expected below average through 2026, with about a 30% deficit from January to May 2027. Salinity of 4 g/L could reach tens of kilometres inland in February-April.
climate.source: Vietnam National Centre for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting via Viet Nam News, 26 Sep 2026
